finding: ASCENDANCY Contribution Lab labels contributors SUPPORTED_INCREMENTAL at n>=8 when a naive normal 95% CI on paired log-score gains is above zero and positive_fraction>=0.65. The implementation does not establish episode independence, dependence-aware uncertainty, multiplicity control, protected OOS status, or cost realism; therefore the label is descriptive screening evidence, not validated incremental predictive edge.

aion.finding: Preserve ASCENDANCY paired log-score observations as exact-revision descriptive memory, but do not encode SUPPORTED_INCREMENTAL as validated predictive knowledge without dependence-aware/OOS evidence.

ascension.finding: n>=8 plus naive normal CI and sign fraction does not establish statistically admissible incremental information under temporal dependence, selection, or multiplicity.

prometheus.finding: A dependence-aware, purged temporal OOS contribution test with multiplicity accounting will materially reduce false SUPPORTED_INCREMENTAL classifications while retaining genuinely incremental contributors.
